answer: Plant every identity as a cedar seedling on a terraced hillside: it grows one ring per epoch, and only if a rotating jury of strangers verifies a real delivery. Rings are public, so age cannot be faked — a farmer can buy a thousand seedlings but cannot buy time, and each must keep working or wither to the lowest terrace. Higher terraces grant more work, and each climb costs a marble marker, a token locked to the identity and shattered if it ever cheats. Forging a thousand faces means tending a thousand cedars through a thousand slow seasons, each doing real work under strangers' eyes.
